US Senator Lindsey Graham dies after 'brief and sudden illness'
latvia.description: Graham, a prominent Republican voice on foreign policy, had recently returned from Ukraine, where he met with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Kyiv.

latvia.title: Georgia left off NATO summit partner list as critics decry isolation
latvia.description: The Georgian government is facing accusations of international isolation after not being invited to the NATO summit in Turkey, the first time a key partner has been excluded from the alliance's agenda.

latvia.title: Was Erdoğan's gun gift a faux pas or an old-school diplomatic tradition?
latvia.description: When NATO leaders opened their gift boxes from the Turkish president and found a .357 Magnum revolver, some panicked and others laughed. But gifting heads of state lavish, personalised firearms is a tradition as old as Samuel Colt — and as recent as a Czech pistol presented to Trump in 2019.

latvia.title: Newly released footage shows revolver gifted by Erdogan to NATO leaders
latvia.description: Images shared by the Lithuanian Presidency show a revolver given by Turkey's Erdogan to every NATO leader as a parting gift after the summit in Ankara. Each leader received a box containing a revolver engraved with their name, six bullets and a note exempting the weapons from export control.

latvia.title: Amit a billentyűzet nem tud: ezért írunk ma is kézzel
latvia.description: A kézírás reneszánsza: megőrzi a mozdulatot, a pillanatot és az embert is, aki létrehozta. Nemcsak információt közvetít, hanem személyes nyomot is hagy maga után.

latvia.title: 3,5 kilométeres magánút építésével vinnék a BYD-gyárból az autókat a dorozsmai vasútállomásra
latvia.description: A szegedi gyárban várhatóan ezer autó készülne naponta, ezek közül hétszázat a Waberer's vasúti terminálján tennének tehervonatokra. A Tiborcz István érdekeltségében lévő cég most is ellát a BYD-hoz kapcsolódó logisztikai feladatokat: több ezer konténer Kínából Magyarországra szállításában vesz részt.

latvia.title: Kocsis Máté úgy kért bocsánatot Simor Andrástól, hogy egyből jelezte: nem gondolja komolyan
latvia.description: „Erre köteleztek”.

latvia.title: Magyar Péternek felajánlották a Mercedes gyárátadóján, hogy vigye el egy körre az új, C osztályos elektromos autót
latvia.description: „Úgy hallottam, nagyon jó sofőr” – mondta a Mercedes-Benz vezérigazgatója a magyar miniszterelnökről, amikor együtt átadták a Mercedes-Benz kecskeméti gyárának bővítését. Magyar Péter miniszterelnök a német–magyar kapcsolatokat méltatta, de azt is közölte, mit vár el kormánya a külföldi beruházóktól.

latvia.title: Egyre több magyar cég használja az AI-t – igaz, többnyire szövegfordításra
latvia.description: A fordítás mellett a kivonatolásban és a levélírásban merül ki egyelőre a nagy mesterségesintelligencia-nekibuzdulás.

latvia.title: A tervezettnél is több embert küldhet el a Volkswagen, további 50 ezer állás van veszélyben
latvia.description: A Volkswagen vezérigazgatója egy belső dokumentumban arra figyelmeztetette a cég munkavállalóit, hogy a vállalatnál akár további 50 ezer munkahely is megszűnhet, ha a cég el akarja érni a versenytársakéhoz hasonló költséghatékonyságot.

latvia.title: Ako vyzerá brigáda na Pohode? Niektorí dostávajú aj 10-15 eur za hodinu a k tomu vreckové
latvia.description: V ankete prezradili aj to, či majú zabezpečenú stravu a ubytovanie.

latvia.title: Vývoj bojov (1601. deň): Únos, vražda a útek veliteľa, ukrajinská armáda rieši zločin v problémovej brigáde
latvia.description: Škandál postihol 155. mechanizovanú brigádu, motív zločinu je triviálny a hlúpy. Ruská flotila v Azovskom mori de facto prestala existovať. Rusi odpovedajú útokmi v Odeskej oblasti. Kosťantynivka stále nepadla a potrvá týždne, kým sa to stane, priznávajú aj Rusi. Do Dobropille sa prvýkrát infiltrovali ruskí vojaci. Ruský tlak na Orichiv sa takmer zastavil, ruská armáda sa pravdepodobne preskupuje pred […]

latvia.title: Babiš odmítl obnovení schůzek s Pavlem. Koordinace je důležitá, reaguje Hrad
latvia.description: Premiér Andrej Babiš (ANO) v neděli pro ČT řekl, že neplánuje obnovit koordinační schůzky s prezidentem Petrem Pavlem ohledně zahraniční a bezpečnostní politiky. Podle jeho slov se pohled vlády a hlavy státu na zahraniční politiku liší, a neví tedy, co by s prezidentem měl řešit. Zmínil také, že by na schůzky neměl čas. Pavel na summitu NATO v Ankaře avizoval, že obnovení pravidelných setkání nejvyšších ústavních činitelů znovu navrhne. Pavel bude podle mluvčího Hradu Víta Koláře dále usilovat o spolupráci, protože považuje koordinaci ústavních činitelů za důležitou.

latvia.title: Zemřel vlivný republikánský senátor Lindsey Graham
latvia.description: Zemřel americký senátor Lindsey Graham, uvedla agentura Reuters s odkazem na politikovu kancelář. Jednasedmdesátiletý republikán patřil k nejvlivnějším členům Kongresu, a to hlavně v zahraniční politice. V posledních letech podporoval Ukrajinu a její boj proti ruské agresi. Americký prezident Donald Trump označil Grahama za jednoho z nejlepších zákonodárců a skutečného amerického vlastence. Bude hodně chybět, dodal. Grahama ocenili rovněž izraelští a evropští politici.

latvia.title: Čína a Rusko v době summitu NATO upořádaly vojenské cvičení v Tichomoří
latvia.description: Důležitým tématem summitu NATO v Ankaře byl kromě obranných výdajů a Ukrajiny i Indopacifik. Aliance hledá novou formu spolupráce se spojenci v Tichomoří, kteří se jednání také zúčastnili. Cílem je čelit rostoucí hrozbě Číny a Ruska, které v době summitu navíc uspořádaly společné vojenské manévry. Cvičení končí v neděli.

latvia.title: Nicușor Dan: România condamnă atacurile cibernetice ale Rusiei împotriva UE și NATO. Mesajul președintelui, după anunțul UE și al UK
latvia.description: Președintele Nicușor Dan a transmis luni că „România condamnă ferm activitățile cibernetice ostile desfășurate de grupări controlate de Serviciul Federal de Securitate al Federației Ruse”, împotriva statelor membre UE, a aliațulor NATo, incluisv împotriva României. Șeful statului spune că atacurile cibernetice sunt „parte dintr-o campanie hibridă mai amplă, menită să submineze stabilitatea democrațiilor”.

latvia.title: Azilele din Bihor: Viorel Pașca, familia lui și coordonatoarea azilelor vor fi cercetați în libertate. Decizia Curții de Apel București
latvia.description: Viorel Paşca, soţia şi cei trei fii ai săi, precum şi coordonatoarea activităţilor de la azilele ilegale din Bihor vor fi cercetați în libertate, după ce Curtea de Apel a respins cererea DIICOT de arestare preventivă și i-a scos și de sub control judiciar, așa cum stabilise prima instanță în acest caz. Decizia este definitivă.

latvia.title: Senatorul republican Mitch McConnell, în vârstă de 84 de ani, a oferit detalii despre sănătatea sa, după săptămâni de absență
latvia.description: Senatorul republican Mitch McConnell, o figură marcantă a vieţii politice din Statele Unite, a risipit misterul din jurul stării sale de sănătate, dezvăluind duminică faptul că a fost spitalizat din cauza unei pierderi de cunoştinţă provocate de o căzătură, urmată de o pneumonie, notează AFP.

latvia.title: Medicul legist a emis concluziile preliminare în urma morții senatorului Lindsey Graham
latvia.description: Senatorul Lindsey Graham, unul dintre cei mai apropiaţi aliaţi ai preşedintelui Donald Trump din Congres, care a călătorit în întreaga lume pentru a pleda în favoarea unei politici externe mai agresive a SUA, a decedat sâmbătă seara „în urma unei boli scurte și subite”. Medicul legist a emis și prima ipoteză în legătură cu cauza decesului.

latvia.title: Agricultură la mila vremii. Cu ce au înlocuit fermierii din vestul țării culturile de cereale, în lipsa sistemelor de irigații
latvia.description: Peste șapte milioane de hectare de teren agricol din România funcționează fără irigații, la mila vremii. În județul Arad, mai puțin de 2% din suprafața cultivată este irigată, așa că, în ultimi ani, tot mai mulți dintre agricultori au înlocuit culturile de cereale cu păduri. Prin comparație, peste graniță, fermierii din Ungaria au investit în sisteme de irigații, pe care le alimentează cu apă cumpărată, în mod paradoxal, din România.

latvia.title: Rusia susţine că Ucraina a lovit un petrolier rus în Marea Azov. Kievul publică imagini în care se vede distrugerea a 14 nave ruseşti
latvia.description: O dronă ucraineană a lovit un petrolier în timp ce acesta intra în Canalul Azov-Marea Neagră, a anunţat duminică Iuri Sliusar, guvernatorul regiunii ruse Rostov, relatează Reuters, citată de News.ro.

latvia.title: Ministerul Apărării: Dronele au schimbat războiul. NATO investește peste 40 de miliarde de dolari în programul Drone Edge
latvia.description: NATO a creat programul Drone Edge, o inițiativă a organizației prin care se urmărește dezvoltarea și achiziția de capabilități moderne pentru detectarea și combatarea dronelor. Ministerul Apărării din România explică că programul a fost necesar din cauza faptului că dronele au schimbat modul în care se poartă războiul.

latvia.title: Senatorul american Lindsey Graham, aliatul lui Trump și susținător al Ucrainei, a murit „în urma unei boli scurte și subite”
latvia.description: Lindsey Graham, republican din Carolina de Sud, care a fost ales în Senat în 2003 și a fost un aliat politic apropiat de-ai președintelui Donald Trump, a decedat, a confirmat biroul său duminică dimineața. Avea 71 de ani. Graham a decedat sâmbătă seara „în urma unei boli scurte și subite”, a precizat biroul său într-un comunicat citat de NBC News.

latvia.title: Nu există expunere „sigură” la soare fără protecție, arată un nou studiu. Care sunt riscurile
latvia.description: Chiar şi perioadele scurte de expunere la soare, la intervale orare considerate în mod tradiţional „sigure”, pot să provoace leziuni cutanate şi să contribuie la creşterea riscului de cancer de piele, conform concluziilor unui studiu australian.

latvia.title: Momentul de cotitură pentru Europa. Cât de realist e termenul 2030 pentru un conflict NATO-Rusia: ofițerii militari au păreri diferite
latvia.description: Oamenii lui Putin apar brusc în Narva, un mic oraș de graniță de la marginea flancului estic al NATO din Estonia. Ei seamănă semințele discordiei și susțin că populația majoritară vorbitoare de limbă rusă este discriminată. Este începutul unui scenariu de conflict Rusia-NATO. Ofițerii militari din Europa cred că cel mai periculos moment pentru continent va veni în anii de după un acord de pace în Ucraina. Ar putea Rusia să atace Estonia?

latvia.title: Estonia construiește o nouă bază militară la granița cu Rusia. Până la 1.000 de soldați vor fi desfășurați la Narva
latvia.description: Autoritățile estoniene au confirmat că au început pregătirile pentru construirea unei noi baze militare în orașul Narva, situat chiar la frontiera cu Rusia. După aprobarea unui acord de schimb de terenuri între stat și Consiliul Local Narva, o tabără modulară provizorie va putea găzdui până la 150 de militari până la începutul anului 2027, iar complexul permanent ar urma să fie finalizat în vara anului 2028. Facilitatea va avea capacitatea de a găzdui până la 1.000 de militari și va avea staționați permanent aproximativ 200 de soldați din Brigada 1 Infanterie.

latvia.title: România, vizată de atacuri cibernetice ale Rusiei, spune Nicușor Dan. „Alături de UE și NATO, transmitem un mesaj clar”
latvia.description: Activitățile cibernetice ostile, desfășurate de grupări controlate de Serviciul Federal de Securitate al Federației Ruse, au vizat state membre ale Uniunii Europene și NATO, inclusiv România, precizează luni președintele Nicușor Dan într-o postare pe Facebook. „România condamnă ferm activitățile cibernetice ostile desfășurate de grupări controlate de Serviciul Federal de Securitate al Federației Ruse”, spune el. …

latvia.title: MPs: Estonia loses a 'good friend' with US Senator Lindsey Graham's death
latvia.description: U.S. Senator Lindsey Graham, who died on Saturday, was a "good" and "steadfast" friend of Estonia, and his unexpected death is a loss for regional security, Estonia's politicians have said.

latvia.title: Russian disinformation surge may be connected to upcoming Baltic elections
latvia.description: An uptick in Russian disinformation aimed at NATO's eastern flank could be linked to Latvia and Estonia's upcoming parliamentary elections, experts say.

latvia.title: Estonia joins other 2 Baltic states in protest over Russian airspace claims
latvia.description: The foreign ministries of Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania have issued a statement strongly rejecting disinformation efforts by Russia's Foreign Ministry over alleged use of their airspace in drone strikes on Russia.

latvia.title: Russia planning to make sarcastic use of international courts against Baltics
latvia.description: Russia, a country that is a serial offender with scant regard for rule of law, nevertheless intends to use international courts to drag the Baltic states through various inconvenient and costly legal processes, according to a new report by the Re:Baltica investigative journalism portal.

latvia.title: Latvia's honorary consuls muster in Rīga
latvia.description: From 13th to 15th July 2026, the Latvian Ministry of Foreign Affairs will host the 12th Meeting of Latvian Honorary Consuls to provide updates on current issues in Latvian foreign policy, key security policy matters and opportunities for bilateral economic and cultural cooperation.

latvia.title: Search continues for missing diver in Baltic Sea
latvia.description: On Sunday, July 12th, at 2:00 p.m., the Maritime Search and Rescue Coordination Center of the Coast Guard received information about a missing diver approximately 10 nautical miles northeast of Roja, Latvia in the Baltic Sea.

latvia.title: Three concert ideas for this week in Latvia
latvia.description: LSM's cultural news editor has a few recommendations to ensure you top up your cultural quotient this week as well as your tan.

latvia.title: Latvia does okay on hospital bed provision
latvia.description: Fresh Eurostat data published on July 13th shows that Latvia is pretty much average among its EU peers when it comes to providing hospital beds for the treatment of its population.

latvia.title: Latvian startup launches transport sector 'reputation network'
latvia.description: CarrierTrust, a Latvia-based startup, has launched an EU-focused reputation network for the European transport and logistics industry, reports Labs of Latvia.

latvia.title: Latvia buys back forest from Swedish owners for 26 million euros
latvia.description: The Latvian state-owned company AS "Latvijas Valsts meži" (LVM) has purchased almost 5,000 hectares of forest land in Pasienes parish, Ludza region, from its previous Swedish owners for just over 26 million euros, the Ministry of Agriculture (ZM) announced on July 13th.

latvia.title: Baltic Sea beauty spots are turning into a load of rubbish
latvia.description: On the Vidzeme coast in northern Latvia, many vacationers who want to be by the sea, as well as foreign tourists, gladly choose to stop at the free parking lots on the A1 highway, which runs parallel with the Baltic Sea shore.

latvia.title: Sunny start to the weather week in Latvia
latvia.description: The weather in Latvia will be mostly sunny on Monday, according to forecasts, with a warm week to follow.

latvia.title: New packaging rules apply soon
latvia.description: A new regulation on packaging and packaging waste will come into force on August 12th. It includes tea bags and mascara brushes as packaging and includes several changes regarding the volume of packaging and the harmful substances it contains. It also sets new requirements for the recycling and reuse of packaging.

latvia.description: An orange warning (danger) for thunderstorms is in place for south-eastern Latvia on Sunday evening.

latvia.description: Train traffic in Riga was affected on Sunday as the result to a tragic accident, the LETA news agency reported.

latvia.title: The Deep Roots of Resilience: what a crown taught me about today’s Ukraine
latvia.description: Have you ever held a real crown in your hands? Not just looked at it from behind glass, but actually felt its weight, touched its curves, and placed it on your head? I have that experience, and I am ready to share it.

latvia.title: 4.8% of Latvia's jobs are in culture
latvia.description: Latvia has slightly more workers in the cultural sector than the EU average, according to figures published by Eurostat on July 10th.

latvia.title: Turkish citizens killed in Latvian car crash
latvia.description: The weekend got off to a tragic start on Latvia's roads with six people killed in several road accidents.

latvia.title: Otto Fischer: Legendary football trainer of the Barcelona of the Baltics
latvia.description: Even in Liepāja, the name Otto Fischer is little known these days. Yet the Austrian-Jewish football coach was once the talk of the city and left an indelible mark in the history of Latvian football. Now his achievements have finally been honored and brought back into the public memory.

latvia.title: Baltic states 'strongly reject' Russian lies in Moscow
latvia.description: Diplomats from the Baltic states on Friday strongly rejected disinformation efforts of the Russian Foreign Ministry in Moscow.

latvia.title: No decision made on LMT/Tet ownership issues
latvia.description: In-depth negotiations are currently under way with no fewer than 23 investors regarding potential involvement in the purchase of shares of LMT and Tet from the Swedish telecommunications company Telia. This was stated by Economics Minister Viktors Valainis (Greens and Farmers' Union, ZZS) after an extraordinary government meeting convened specifically for this issue on July 10th.

latvia.title: Latvia's foreign trade figures were on the up in May
latvia.description: Central Statistical Bureau provisional data show that in May 2026 Latvia had foreign trade turnover of 3.86 billion euro, and at current prices it was 8.4 % higher than a year ago.

latvia.title: Lithuanian arrested in big cigarette seizure in Rīga
latvia.description: Tax and Customs Police officers, in cooperation with State Border Guard officers, conducted an inspection of a warehouse in Rīga, in the Teika suburb, at the end of June this year. During the search, a large quantity of cigarettes, vehicles, tracking devices and other items were seized, indicating an intention to covertly transport a large quantity of cigarettes of illegal origin.

latvia.title: 'Lion's Leap' military exercises taking place this weekend
latvia.description: From July 11 to 12, the international military exercise “Lions Leap” will be held in the vicinity of Ozolaine, Vecsaule parish, Bauska district, in which the 53rd Infantry Battalion of the 1st Riga Brigade of the National Guard, the 503rd Infantry Company of the Lithuanian National Guard, and soldiers of the 2025 draft of the State Defense Service will participate.

latvia.title: Latvia celebrates 50th heart transplant
latvia.description: The 50th heart transplant in Latvia has taken place at Pauls Stradiņš Clinical University Hospital (PSKUS), reports Latvian Television.

latvia.title: Young jazz musicians to shine through summer concert competition
latvia.description: The jazz club "M/Darbnīca – M/House of Jazz" is holding a new generation jazz competition "Young and Talented" on Wednesdays in July and August, which takes place in the format of a concert cycle, reports Latvian Television.

latvia.title: Rīga introduces management fees for municipal apartments
latvia.description: From this month, Rīga will start collecting management fees for municipality-owned apartments.

latvia.title: Wind turbine loses blade during test run in Latvia
latvia.description: A loud noise, reminiscent of thunder, shook the Karosta neighbourhood in Liepāja on Wednesday evening. Although strong winds were battering the city in Kurzeme, the cause this time was different: during equipment testing at the Rapsoil wind farm, the blade of one turbine snapped and fell. The rotor is located on the outskirts of the city; no one was injured, TV Kurzeme reports.

latvia.title: Ostapenko wins first Wimbledon mixed doubles title
latvia.description: Latvian tennis star Aļona Ostapenko, paired with Salvadoran Marcelo Arevalo, won the mixed doubles final at the Wimbledon Championships on Thursday. It is the former French Open champion's first grand slam title on grass.

latvia.title: Three for the Weekend: Festivals abound
latvia.description: Which festival will you choose for this weekend?

latvia.title: Dry and hot weather to begin in Latvia Sunday
latvia.description: Starting Sunday, the weather in Latvia will become drier and warmer, and will often be even hot, according to forecasts by weatherman Toms Bricis.

latvia.title: Latvia is Belarus' first target for hybrid war: Border Guard chief
latvia.description: Latvia is currently the number one target of Belarus’s hybrid warfare, and the challenges are immense, Guntis Pujāts, commander of the State Border Guard, told Latvian Television on July 9 regarding the situation on the eastern border.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 9th July, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: University enrolment begins in Latvia Thursday
latvia.description: On Thursday, July 9, the unified admissions process for undergraduate programs began at eight Latvian universities. Online applications for admission will continue on the “Latvija.lv” portal from Thursday through July 20, while prospective students will be able to apply in person starting July 14, Latvian Radio reports.

latvia.title: Staged robbery uncovered in Ogre, Latvia
latvia.description: The State Police have uncovered a staged robbery in Ogre that was organised to conceal the embezzlement of company funds, police said on July 9.

latvia.title: Organic dairy brand Bryunaļa discontinued in Latvia
latvia.description: The agricultural services cooperative “Viļāni” has a wide range of organic dairy products and the “Bryunaļa” brand, which was launched 11 years ago. Due to the unprofitability of the production facility, a decision was made to discontinue the production of organic dairy products as of July 10, Latvian Radio reported on July 9.

latvia.title: Man drives luxury cars, steals fuel and sandwiches
latvia.description: Police officers in Pārdaugava arrested a young man who, since this spring, had stolen fuel from at least six gas stations in Rīga and the surrounding area using luxury cars. The suspect is currently being held in temporary custody, according to the State Police.

latvia.title: Election candidate removed due to lack of Latvian citizenship
latvia.description: The Central Election Commission (CVK) decided on Thursday to remove Jurijs Jesipenko from the list of candidates for the 15th Saeima election in the Rīga electoral district submitted by the political party alliance “Harmony Centre,” the CVK told the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: PM Kulbergs rates his cabinet '7 out of 10' after first month in office
latvia.description: The government of Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (United List) has fully completed three of a total of 61 priority tasks within a month, he announced at a press conference after a meeting to discuss the government's actions so far.

latvia.title: 'Key figures on Europe' 2026 edition now available
latvia.description: On July 9th Eurostat has released the 2026 edition of its Key figures on Europe.

latvia.title: Latvia's macroeconomic forecasts revised by Finance Ministry
latvia.description: The Ministry of Finance (FM) has updated its indicative medium-term macroeconomic and fiscal forecasts, taking into account the latest economic trends and the geopolitical situation. The forecasts indicate slower economic growth and higher inflation than projected in February of this year, the FM reported.

latvia.title: Lots of lilies coming to Latvian Nature Museum
latvia.description: From July 16 to 18, the Latvian National Museum of Natural History will host “Lilies 2026,” a particularly colourful and fragrant exhibition for the gardening season, the museum announced.

latvia.title: Two minors get prison sentence for double homicide
latvia.description: Two minors have been sentenced to 12 years and six months in prison and three years of probation for the murder of two people in Rēzekne, the Latgale District Court has ruled, according to the Prosecutor's Office.

latvia.title: Central Rīga street sections to be closed until end of July
latvia.description: To complete the installation of bike lanes and improvements to street intersections on the section of Dzirnavu Street between Tērbatas Street and Skolas Street, starting Thursday, July 9, through July 30, traffic restrictions will be in place on Dzirnavu Street, according to the Riga City Council.

latvia.title: Railway platform modernization project has big problems
latvia.description: The project to make Latvia's crumbling railway platforms resemble something from the 21st century is experiencing severe delays, reports Latvian Radio.

latvia.title: Baltic air policing mission switches to air defence mission
latvia.description: NATO will reassign its longstanding Baltic air policing mission as an air defence mission, according to an agreement reached at a summit of NATO member states' leaders in the Turkish capital, Ankara, reports Latvian Television.

latvia.title: AI data centre to help Latvian doctors make quicker diagnoses
latvia.description: Time is of the essence in diagnosing diseases, including cancer, as well as in selecting the most appropriate treatment methods. Thanks to high-performance computing, what used to take years can now be analysed much more quickly. A new artificial intelligence data server will provide Latvian scientists with this opportunity, Latvian Television reported.

latvia.title: Latvian Border Guard chief: Migrant smugglers are getting aggressive
latvia.description: Migrant smugglers have become more aggressive, and border guards are having to use increasingly aggressive methods to apprehend them, said Guntis Pujāts, commander of the State Border Guard (VRS), in an interview on the Latvian Radio programme “Good Morning” on July 9.

latvia.title: Latvian SUBmerge to work with industry giant Naval Group
latvia.description: On Wednesday, July 8, the Latvian underwater drone manufacturer "SUBmerge Baltic" signed a memorandum of cooperation with the French defence and maritime technology company "Naval Group," Latvian Radio reported on July 8.

latvia.title: Drones help check power lines in Latvia
latvia.description: Work that used to take several hours in some places can now be completed in a matter of minutes. The electricity distribution network "Sadales tīkls" is increasingly using drones to inspect power lines, Latvian Television reported on July 8.

latvia.title: Vanšu tilta remonts var radīt pamatīgas galvassāpes autovadītājiem – zināms, ko plāno Rīgas dome
latvia.description: Gatavojoties vērienīgajiem Vanšu tilta remontdarbiem, Rīgas dome apsver būtiskas satiksmes organizācijas izmaiņas. Viens no scenārijiem paredz uz būvdarbu laiku slēgt Vanšu tiltu privātajam transportam, vienlaikus izveidojot jaunus “park & ride” stāvlaukumus abās Daugavas pusēs, intervijā TV3 raidījumam “900 sekundes” atklāja Rīgas domes priekšsēdētājs Viesturs Kleinbergs. Viņš uzsvēra, ka remontdarbi, kas jūtami ietekmēs satiksmi pār Vanšu […]

latvia.title: Bites šogad pastrādājušas godam – vai tas ietekmēs arī medus cenas?
latvia.description: Šī gada laikapstākļi biškopjiem līdz šim bijuši labvēlīgi, tāpēc Latvijā kopumā tiek prognozēta laba medus raža. Latvijas Biškopības biedrības valdes priekšsēdētājs Valters Brusbārdis norāda, ka sezona vēl turpināsies visu jūliju un arī augustā, kad ziedēs virši, taču līdzšinējās prognozes ir iepriecinošas. Brusbārdis atzīmēja, ka šogad kopumā laikapstākļi ir labvēlīgi, piebilstot, ka ūdens patlaban augiem pietiek […]

latvia.title: Neticams atradums Norvēģijas ūdeņos: atrasts gandrīz 300 gadus sens kuģa vraks ar neskartu kravu
latvia.description: Norvēģijas ūdeņos arheologi atklājuši 18. gadsimta kuģa vraku, kurā atrasta viena no vislabāk saglabātajām šāda veida kravām, kāda jebkad atrasta Ziemeļeiropā. Eksperti to raksturo kā īstu laika kapsulu, kas vairākus gadsimtus gulējusi jūras dzelmē. Par atradumu jūnija sākumā paziņoja Norvēģijas Kultūras mantojuma direktorāts. Kuģa vraku aptuveni 600 metru dziļumā Skageraka šaurumā pie Norvēģijas dienvidaustrumu krastiem […]

latvia.title: Šajos mēnešos dzimušajiem dzīvē veicas biežāk! 8 īpašības, kas viņus atšķir no citiem
latvia.description: Vai dzimšanas mēnesis var ietekmēt cilvēka raksturu? Zinātnieku vidū par to joprojām nav vienprātības, tomēr daļa pētnieku un psihologu uzskata, ka gadalaiks, kurā cilvēks nāk pasaulē, var būt saistīts ar noteiktām personības iezīmēm. Savukārt astrologi norāda, ka cilvēkiem, kuri dzimuši vasarā un agrā rudenī, bieži piemīt īpašības, kas palīdz vieglāk veidot attiecības, pārvarēt grūtības un […]

latvia.title: Kārlis Streips: Būdams žurnālists, nekad publiski neesmu atzinis, par ko esmu balsojis, bet vienu varu pateikt gan…
latvia.description: Esmu piedalījies vēlēšanās kopš brīža, kad man Amerikā pienāca pareizais vecums. Mans vectētis bija aktīvs Republikāņu partijā, un pirmoreiz, kad balsoju 1980. gadā, nobalsoju par Ronaldu Reiganu. Laikā kopš tam gan es allaž esmu balsojis par Demokrātu partijas kandidātiem, jo republikāņi pakāpeniski ir kļuvuši radikālāki un naidīgāki pret visiem, kuri viņiem nepatīk. Latvijā dzīvojot esmu […]

lithuania.title: US Senator Lindsey Graham dies after 'brief and sudden illness'
lithuania.description: Graham, a prominent Republican voice on foreign policy, had recently returned from Ukraine, where he met with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Kyiv.

lithuania.title: Georgia left off NATO summit partner list as critics decry isolation
lithuania.description: The Georgian government is facing accusations of international isolation after not being invited to the NATO summit in Turkey, the first time a key partner has been excluded from the alliance's agenda.

lithuania.title: Was Erdoğan's gun gift a faux pas or an old-school diplomatic tradition?
lithuania.description: When NATO leaders opened their gift boxes from the Turkish president and found a .357 Magnum revolver, some panicked and others laughed. But gifting heads of state lavish, personalised firearms is a tradition as old as Samuel Colt — and as recent as a Czech pistol presented to Trump in 2019.

lithuania.title: Newly released footage shows revolver gifted by Erdogan to NATO leaders
lithuania.description: Images shared by the Lithuanian Presidency show a revolver given by Turkey's Erdogan to every NATO leader as a parting gift after the summit in Ankara. Each leader received a box containing a revolver engraved with their name, six bullets and a note exempting the weapons from export control.

lithuania.title: Amit a billentyűzet nem tud: ezért írunk ma is kézzel
lithuania.description: A kézírás reneszánsza: megőrzi a mozdulatot, a pillanatot és az embert is, aki létrehozta. Nemcsak információt közvetít, hanem személyes nyomot is hagy maga után.

lithuania.title: 3,5 kilométeres magánút építésével vinnék a BYD-gyárból az autókat a dorozsmai vasútállomásra
lithuania.description: A szegedi gyárban várhatóan ezer autó készülne naponta, ezek közül hétszázat a Waberer's vasúti terminálján tennének tehervonatokra. A Tiborcz István érdekeltségében lévő cég most is ellát a BYD-hoz kapcsolódó logisztikai feladatokat: több ezer konténer Kínából Magyarországra szállításában vesz részt.

lithuania.title: Kocsis Máté úgy kért bocsánatot Simor Andrástól, hogy egyből jelezte: nem gondolja komolyan
lithuania.description: „Erre köteleztek”.

lithuania.title: Egyre több magyar cég használja az AI-t – igaz, többnyire szövegfordításra
lithuania.description: A fordítás mellett a kivonatolásban és a levélírásban merül ki egyelőre a nagy mesterségesintelligencia-nekibuzdulás.

lithuania.title: Babiš odmítl obnovení schůzek s Pavlem. Koordinace je důležitá, reaguje Hrad
lithuania.description: Premiér Andrej Babiš (ANO) v neděli pro ČT řekl, že neplánuje obnovit koordinační schůzky s prezidentem Petrem Pavlem ohledně zahraniční a bezpečnostní politiky. Podle jeho slov se pohled vlády a hlavy státu na zahraniční politiku liší, a neví tedy, co by s prezidentem měl řešit. Zmínil také, že by na schůzky neměl čas. Pavel na summitu NATO v Ankaře avizoval, že obnovení pravidelných setkání nejvyšších ústavních činitelů znovu navrhne. Pavel bude podle mluvčího Hradu Víta Koláře dále usilovat o spolupráci, protože považuje koordinaci ústavních činitelů za důležitou.

lithuania.title: Zemřel vlivný republikánský senátor Lindsey Graham
lithuania.description: Zemřel americký senátor Lindsey Graham, uvedla agentura Reuters s odkazem na politikovu kancelář. Jednasedmdesátiletý republikán patřil k nejvlivnějším členům Kongresu, a to hlavně v zahraniční politice. V posledních letech podporoval Ukrajinu a její boj proti ruské agresi. Americký prezident Donald Trump označil Grahama za jednoho z nejlepších zákonodárců a skutečného amerického vlastence. Bude hodně chybět, dodal. Grahama ocenili rovněž izraelští a evropští politici.

lithuania.title: Čína a Rusko v době summitu NATO upořádaly vojenské cvičení v Tichomoří
lithuania.description: Důležitým tématem summitu NATO v Ankaře byl kromě obranných výdajů a Ukrajiny i Indopacifik. Aliance hledá novou formu spolupráce se spojenci v Tichomoří, kteří se jednání také zúčastnili. Cílem je čelit rostoucí hrozbě Číny a Ruska, které v době summitu navíc uspořádaly společné vojenské manévry. Cvičení končí v neděli.

lithuania.title: Nicușor Dan: România condamnă atacurile cibernetice ale Rusiei împotriva UE și NATO. Mesajul președintelui, după anunțul UE și al UK
lithuania.description: Președintele Nicușor Dan a transmis luni că „România condamnă ferm activitățile cibernetice ostile desfășurate de grupări controlate de Serviciul Federal de Securitate al Federației Ruse”, împotriva statelor membre UE, a aliațulor NATo, incluisv împotriva României. Șeful statului spune că atacurile cibernetice sunt „parte dintr-o campanie hibridă mai amplă, menită să submineze stabilitatea democrațiilor”.

lithuania.title: Azilele din Bihor: Viorel Pașca, familia lui și coordonatoarea azilelor vor fi cercetați în libertate. Decizia Curții de Apel București
lithuania.description: Viorel Paşca, soţia şi cei trei fii ai săi, precum şi coordonatoarea activităţilor de la azilele ilegale din Bihor vor fi cercetați în libertate, după ce Curtea de Apel a respins cererea DIICOT de arestare preventivă și i-a scos și de sub control judiciar, așa cum stabilise prima instanță în acest caz. Decizia este definitivă.

lithuania.title: Senatorul republican Mitch McConnell, în vârstă de 84 de ani, a oferit detalii despre sănătatea sa, după săptămâni de absență
lithuania.description: Senatorul republican Mitch McConnell, o figură marcantă a vieţii politice din Statele Unite, a risipit misterul din jurul stării sale de sănătate, dezvăluind duminică faptul că a fost spitalizat din cauza unei pierderi de cunoştinţă provocate de o căzătură, urmată de o pneumonie, notează AFP.

lithuania.title: Medicul legist a emis concluziile preliminare în urma morții senatorului Lindsey Graham
lithuania.description: Senatorul Lindsey Graham, unul dintre cei mai apropiaţi aliaţi ai preşedintelui Donald Trump din Congres, care a călătorit în întreaga lume pentru a pleda în favoarea unei politici externe mai agresive a SUA, a decedat sâmbătă seara „în urma unei boli scurte și subite”. Medicul legist a emis și prima ipoteză în legătură cu cauza decesului.

lithuania.title: Rusia susţine că Ucraina a lovit un petrolier rus în Marea Azov. Kievul publică imagini în care se vede distrugerea a 14 nave ruseşti
lithuania.description: O dronă ucraineană a lovit un petrolier în timp ce acesta intra în Canalul Azov-Marea Neagră, a anunţat duminică Iuri Sliusar, guvernatorul regiunii ruse Rostov, relatează Reuters, citată de News.ro.

lithuania.title: Ministerul Apărării: Dronele au schimbat războiul. NATO investește peste 40 de miliarde de dolari în programul Drone Edge
lithuania.description: NATO a creat programul Drone Edge, o inițiativă a organizației prin care se urmărește dezvoltarea și achiziția de capabilități moderne pentru detectarea și combatarea dronelor. Ministerul Apărării din România explică că programul a fost necesar din cauza faptului că dronele au schimbat modul în care se poartă războiul.

lithuania.title: Senatorul american Lindsey Graham, aliatul lui Trump și susținător al Ucrainei, a murit „în urma unei boli scurte și subite”
lithuania.description: Lindsey Graham, republican din Carolina de Sud, care a fost ales în Senat în 2003 și a fost un aliat politic apropiat de-ai președintelui Donald Trump, a decedat, a confirmat biroul său duminică dimineața. Avea 71 de ani. Graham a decedat sâmbătă seara „în urma unei boli scurte și subite”, a precizat biroul său într-un comunicat citat de NBC News.

lithuania.title: Nu există expunere „sigură” la soare fără protecție, arată un nou studiu. Care sunt riscurile
lithuania.description: Chiar şi perioadele scurte de expunere la soare, la intervale orare considerate în mod tradiţional „sigure”, pot să provoace leziuni cutanate şi să contribuie la creşterea riscului de cancer de piele, conform concluziilor unui studiu australian.

lithuania.title: Momentul de cotitură pentru Europa. Cât de realist e termenul 2030 pentru un conflict NATO-Rusia: ofițerii militari au păreri diferite
lithuania.description: Oamenii lui Putin apar brusc în Narva, un mic oraș de graniță de la marginea flancului estic al NATO din Estonia. Ei seamănă semințele discordiei și susțin că populația majoritară vorbitoare de limbă rusă este discriminată. Este începutul unui scenariu de conflict Rusia-NATO. Ofițerii militari din Europa cred că cel mai periculos moment pentru continent va veni în anii de după un acord de pace în Ucraina. Ar putea Rusia să atace Estonia?

lithuania.title: România, vizată de atacuri cibernetice ale Rusiei, spune Nicușor Dan. „Alături de UE și NATO, transmitem un mesaj clar”
lithuania.description: Activitățile cibernetice ostile, desfășurate de grupări controlate de Serviciul Federal de Securitate al Federației Ruse, au vizat state membre ale Uniunii Europene și NATO, inclusiv România, precizează luni președintele Nicușor Dan într-o postare pe Facebook. „România condamnă ferm activitățile cibernetice ostile desfășurate de grupări controlate de Serviciul Federal de Securitate al Federației Ruse”, spune el. …

lithuania.title: MPs: Estonia loses a 'good friend' with US Senator Lindsey Graham's death
lithuania.description: U.S. Senator Lindsey Graham, who died on Saturday, was a "good" and "steadfast" friend of Estonia, and his unexpected death is a loss for regional security, Estonia's politicians have said.

lithuania.title: Russian disinformation surge may be connected to upcoming Baltic elections
lithuania.description: An uptick in Russian disinformation aimed at NATO's eastern flank could be linked to Latvia and Estonia's upcoming parliamentary elections, experts say.

lithuania.title: Estonia joins other 2 Baltic states in protest over Russian airspace claims
lithuania.description: The foreign ministries of Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania have issued a statement strongly rejecting disinformation efforts by Russia's Foreign Ministry over alleged use of their airspace in drone strikes on Russia.

lithuania.title: Lithuanian arrested in big cigarette seizure in Rīga
lithuania.description: Tax and Customs Police officers, in cooperation with State Border Guard officers, conducted an inspection of a warehouse in Rīga, in the Teika suburb, at the end of June this year. During the search, a large quantity of cigarettes, vehicles, tracking devices and other items were seized, indicating an intention to covertly transport a large quantity of cigarettes of illegal origin.

lithuania.title: 'Lion's Leap' military exercises taking place this weekend
lithuania.description: From July 11 to 12, the international military exercise “Lions Leap” will be held in the vicinity of Ozolaine, Vecsaule parish, Bauska district, in which the 53rd Infantry Battalion of the 1st Riga Brigade of the National Guard, the 503rd Infantry Company of the Lithuanian National Guard, and soldiers of the 2025 draft of the State Defense Service will participate.

lithuania.title: Baltic air policing mission switches to air defence mission
lithuania.description: NATO will reassign its longstanding Baltic air policing mission as an air defence mission, according to an agreement reached at a summit of NATO member states' leaders in the Turkish capital, Ankara, reports Latvian Television.

lithuania.title: “Katrai tautai ir savas utis” – Slaidiņš skaidro, kāpēc Polijai un Ukrainai vēsturiskie konflikti jāatliek malā
lithuania.description: Polijas un Ukrainas attiecībās joprojām jūtamas vēsturisko notikumu sekas, tomēr pašreizējā kara laikā abām valstīm būtu svarīgi koncentrēties uz kopīgo apdraudējumu – Krieviju, uzskata NBS majors, Zemessardzes štāba virsnieks Jānis Slaidiņš. Viņš TV24 raidījumā “Aktuālais par karadarbību Ukrainā” norādīja, ka Polijas un Ukrainas vēsturē ir bijuši konflikti, taču katrai tautai ir savi sarežģītie vēstures posmi, […]

lithuania.title: Jāmaina politiskā stratēģija! Zelenskis paziņo par būtiskām pārmaiņām Ukrainas valdībā
lithuania.description: Ukrainā mainīsies ministru kabineta sastāvs, un arī premjerministrei Jūlijai Sviridenko būs jauns amats, svētdien ierakstā platformā “Telegram” paziņoja Ukrainas prezidents Volodimirs Zelenskis. Viņš tieši neprecizēja, kādas būs izmaiņas, taču no viņa rakstītā izriet, ka Sviridenko atstās premjerministres amatu un turpmāk koordinēs Ukrainas attiecības ar vienu no galvenajiem ārvalstu partneriem. Zelenskis nav atklājis, kas varētu Sviridenko […]

lithuania.title: VIDEO. Latvijā radīts sauszemes drons palīdzējis glābt civiliedzīvotājus Ukrainā
lithuania.description: Latvijā radītais sauszemes drons “Natrix” ir sniedzis nenovērtējamu palīdzību un piedalījies civiliedzīvotāju evakuācijā no karadarbības plosītās Limanas pilsētas Ukrainā, palīdzot nogādāt drošībā cilvēkus, kuri nespēj patstāvīgi pārvietoties. Kā norāda “Natrix” komanda, apziņa, ka viņu būvētās sauszemes platformas ik dienu palīdz glābt dzīvības, mudina vēl ciešāk sadarboties ar partneriem, lai attīstītu platformu atbilstoši reālām operatīvajām vajadzībām. […]

lithuania.title: Prispaustų ar sužeistų nebuvo: autobusas nuvertė stulpą, nutraukė laidus, sutrikdė grafikus
lithuania.description: 13 val. 15 min. Antakalnio gatvėje, transporto žiede, autobusas atsitrenkė į elektros stulpą, pranešė delfi.lt „Vairuotoja medikų pagalbos atsisakė, keleivių nėra, prispaustų ar sužeistų – taip pat nėra“, minėtą portalą informavo Vilniaus apskrities policijos atstovė Loreta Kairienė.

lithuania.title: Žiniasklaida: Volodymyras Zelenskis premjero postą siūlo „Naftogaz“ generaliniam direktoriui
lithuania.description: Prezidentas Volodymyras Zelenskis susitiko su Ukrainos valstybinės naftos ir dujų bendrovės „Naftogaz“ generaliniu direktoriumi Serhijumi Koreckiu ir pasiūlė jam ministro pirmininko postą, o S. Koreckis pareiškė esąs pasirengęs užimti šias pareigas, pranešė portalas „Ukrainska pravda“.

lithuania.title: Suomija pastatė slėptuvių tinklą, kuriose gali tilpti visi Helsinkio gyventojai
lithuania.description: Suomija sukūrė vieną iš didžiausių Europoje bombų slėptuvių sistemų, rašo „The Times“. Ji leidžia suteikti prieglobstį Helsinkio gyventojams ir mieste esantiems žmonėms kilus kariniam konfliktui ar susidarius ekstremalioms situacijoms.

lithuania.title: Irano kariuomenė žada neleisti JAV „kištis“ į Hormuzo sąsiaurio valdymą
lithuania.description: Irano kariuomenė pirmadienį įspėjo, kad neleis Jungtinėms Valstijoms „kištis“ į Hormuzo sąsiaurio valdymą.

lithuania.title: Vasarišką šilumą dalyje Lietuvos pakeitė kur kas blogesni orai – pasipylė kruša
lithuania.description: Pirmadienis Lietuvoje – pagaliau vėl vasariškai šiltas. Tiesa, pavakarę dalyje šalies orai pasikeitė iš esmės.

lithuania.title: Tokių skaičių nematė daugiau kaip 20 metų: kas vyksta su Rusijos nafta
lithuania.description: Remiantis „EA Analytics“ duomenimis, liepos mėnesį Rusijos naftos perdirbimo gamyklos vidutiniškai perdirbo 3,91 mln. barelių žalios naftos per parą – tai mažiausias rodiklis nuo 2005 m. kovo mėnesio.

lithuania.title: Migrantų kelionės į Vakarus: egiptiečiai judėjo pėsčiomis, tariamas Gambijos pilietis – autobusu
lithuania.description: Vos per keletą valandų pasieniečiai Joniškio rajone nutraukė trijų neteisėtų migrantų kelionę į Vakarų Europą. Du afrikiečiai buvo sulaikyti žingsniuojantys keliu, trečiasis – išsodintas iš tarptautiniu maršrutu važiavusio autobuso. Abiem atvejais užsieniečiai vyko iš Latvijos.

lithuania.title: Trumpas: Jungtinės Valstijos perima Hormuzo sąsiaurį
lithuania.description: Prezidentas Donaldas Trumpas pirmadienį pareiškė, kad Jungtinės Valstijos „perima“ Hormuzo sąsiaurį – strateginį vandens kelią, dėl kurio vykstančios kovos gali sužlugdyti pastangas visam laikui užbaigti karą Artimuosiuose Rytuose.

lithuania.title: Baltijos jūroje dingo naras: ieško net Latvijos karo laivynas
lithuania.description: Latvijos karinės jūrų pajėgos pradėjo paieškos ir gelbėjimo operaciją, siekdamos surasti nardytoją, kuris dingo netoli Ruojos, kai nardė Baltijos jūroje ir tyrinėjo laivo nuolaužas.

lithuania.title: Kremlius deda antrankius Rusijos politikams: sulaikytas buvęs Putino konkurentas
lithuania.description: Rusijos saugumo pajėgos sulaikė politiką Borisą Nadeždiną, kuris anksčiau paskelbė apie savo ketinimus dalyvauti rinkimuose į Valstybės Dūmą. Politiko advokatas naujienų portalui „Agentstvo“ teigė, kad kol kas oficiali sulaikymo priežastis yra neaiški.

lithuania.title: Ukraina ir Rusija apsikeitė smūgiais: abi praneša apie žuvusiuosius
lithuania.description: Per Ukrainos dronų smūgius Rusijoje pirmadienį žuvo keturi žmonės, daugiausia Maskvos regione, o Rusijos smūgiai Ukrainoje, įskaitant smūgį krovininiam laivui, nusinešė mažiausiai šešių žmonių gyvybes, pranešė abiejų šalių pareigūnai.

lithuania.title: Gaisras Neringoje: degė gyvenamosiomis patalpomis paversti garažai
lithuania.description: Praėjusį savaitgalį gaisras kilo Nidoje, taip vadinamame vietos Šanchajuje.

lithuania.title: Pernai vyskupijos sulaukė dviejų kreipimųsi dėl galimo nepilnamečių seksualinio išnaudojimo
lithuania.description: 2025 metais Lietuvos vyskupijose gautos dvi žinios apie galimus nepilnamečių seksualinio išnaudojimo atvejus.
